column1: # Test-pattern colour round trip: each SMPTE bar's median colour.
# Source: TestPatternSource at its default 1280x720, published over WHIP and played back over WHEP.
# Measured from the receiver's WhepPlayer encoded track read at the local relay with tatolab-read-track and decoded by ffmpeg to RGB PNGs.
# Default verification tolerance is ±0.05 absolute on the [0,1] scale, per bar and channel.
